title: Ya shere kaha ho aao darbaare yazeedi me haram hai
body:
Ya Sher E Khuda Kha'n Ho Aaoo
Darbar E Yazeedi Mein Haram Hai
Kunbe Ka Nabi Ke Haal Dekho Darbar E Yazeedi Mein Haram Hai
1. Kulsoom Ko Ek Shaqi Ki Beti
Hai Maang Rahi Paye Kaneezi Kyu Aate Nhi Hai Aap Bolo Darbar E Yazeedi....
<<DIVIDER>>
2.Hai'n Betiyaan Aap Ki Khule Sar
Sar Par Bhi Nhi Hai Ek Chaadar
Balon Se Chupaye Hai Woh Munh Ko Darbar E Yazeedi.....
